Description: A pre-configured Umbraco data type providing a dropdown of Brazil's 27 federative units — the 26 states plus the Distrito Federal. Values are stored in proper case with accents, as written in Portuguese. Umbraco 13 (net8.0) and 17 (net10.0); the data type installs itself on Umbraco 13.
